rv.q: The laughs are too few and very far between in My First Ex-Husband...

And the fact the very smart Joy Behar wrote it makes it even more enticing. I remember the stories in her one person show ‘Me, My Mouth & I” over 10 years ago. Especially that one-liner of appreciation from Steve Allen.

But the good news is that I gained a girlfriend”). The initial cast of performers, all sleekly dressed in black, acquit themselves just fine, though many were still flipping through the pages of the binder while occasionally injecting vocal flourishes for emphasis or character development.

Each actress brought something unique to the show, and to each character they portrayed. They were able to bring Joy Behar’s lines to life in a raw and refreshing manner. Overall, “My First Ex-Husband” was an engaging, liberating, and entertaining play.
